name: ProductOverview
description: Mortar product overview: gallery with selectable thumbnails (or an opt-in image grid showing every image), price, rating, option pickers (native radios, with colour swatches), add to bag and highlights.

props.name: string
props.rating: { value: number; count: number; href?: string }
props.options: ProductOption[] ({ id: string; label: string; values: { value: string; label: string; swatch?: string; disabled?: boolean }[] })
props.gallery: "thumbnails" | "grid" (default "thumbnails"; grid shows all images, first large and the rest tiered beneath)

contract.usage: Import { ProductOverview } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
